## Schools (St. Vrain Valley School District)

1. Highlands Elementary School — grades PK-5, Niche grade A− (summer 2026), #3 elementary in Weld County, 528 students, 17:1 student-teacher ratio. Walkable from the home. https://hles.svvsd.org
2. Soaring Heights PK-8 — grades PK-8, Niche grade B+, #38 K-8 school in Colorado, 1,211 students, 17:1 ratio. One campus from pre-K through 8th grade. https://shpk8.svvsd.org
3. Erie High School — grades 9-12, Niche grade B+, 97% graduation rate, ranked #16 in Colorado for athletes, ~1,727 students. https://ehs.svvsd.org

## Erie Highlands Neighborhood & Lifestyle

Erie Highlands is a family-oriented neighborhood on Erie's west side. The HOA (~$35/month) includes a resort-style pool with waterslide and splash zone, a fitness center, a clubhouse, playgrounds, and miles of community trails connecting to Front Range open space. The neighborhood park has a ball field, playgrounds, and looping trails with mountain views. Highlands Elementary sits inside the neighborhood.

A typical weekend: coffee on the deck, a walk on the community trails, a school drop-off on foot; afternoons at the rec center pool or lunch in Old Town Erie; evenings at the fire pit as the light drops behind the foothills.

## Old Town Erie — Downtown & Dining (~4 minutes away)

Restaurants and bars on and around Briggs Street:
- The Old Mine — craft cidery & brewpub in a restored 1889 mercantile; artisan pizza, house-smoked BBQ; family-friendly. 500 Briggs St. theoldmine.com
- Cellar West Brewery (Erie Tap Room) — craft beer taproom in a 100-year-old home with a beer garden. 445 Briggs St. cellarwest.com
- Birdhouse — ramen, tacos, and tiki cocktails with a rooftop patio. 526 Briggs St. eatatbirdhouse.com
- Lucile's Creole Cafe — award-winning Cajun/Creole breakfast and lunch; beignets. 544 Briggs St. luciles.com
- 24 Carrot Bistro — farm-to-table New American fine dining with craft cocktails. 578 Briggs St. 24carrotbistro.com
- Piripi — tapas and Mediterranean, fully gluten-free, heated rooftop patio. 615 Briggs St, Ste C. piripirestaurant.com
- The Dugout Grill & Bar — casual American bar and grill. 149 S Briggs St, Unit 105. dugoutgrillandbarerie.com
- Cristos Coffee Roastery & Cafe — local roaster, "Erie's living room." 149 S Briggs St. cristoscoffeeco.com
- Fox Dog Coffee — espresso and pastries. 515 Briggs St, Unit A.
- Erie Social Club — wine and whiskey bar with trivia and tastings. 105 Wells St, Ste 120. eriesocialclub.com
- Also: Wapos (Mexican), Echo Brewing & Pizzeria, Sweets (ice cream).

Shops: CyclErie eBikes and Service (e-bike shop near the Coal Creek Trail, 515 Briggs St, store.cyclerie.net) · Young Explorers (kids' STEM toy store with classes, 545 Briggs St) · Briggs Street Books and Music (independent bookstore & record shop, 615 Briggs St).

Downtown hub: downtownerie.biz · Town of Erie downtown page: erieco.gov/2535/Downtown-Erie

## Recreation & Activities in Erie, Colorado

- Erie Community Center (450 Powers St, ~5 min): indoor pool with lazy river and hot tub, full-court gymnasium (basketball/volleyball), racquetball courts, fitness areas, active-adult lounge. erieco.gov/172/Erie-Community-Center
- Youth sports: seasonal soccer, basketball, baseball and more through Town of Erie Parks & Recreation. erieco.gov/1436/Youth-Sports · registration: app.amilia.com/store/en/erierec/shop/programs
- Erie Town Fair & Balloon Festival: the signature summer event, hot-air balloons at dawn. erieballoonfestival.com
- Farmers market and year-round town events: erieco.gov/1540/Events · eriechamber.org/special-events
- Trails: Erie Highlands connects to community trails and Front Range open space; the Coal Creek Trail runs through Old Town.
- Erie Singletrack (Sunset Open Space): ~5 miles of town-managed flow singletrack for mountain biking, e-biking, running and hiking, with progressive green/blue/black skill lines and Front Range views. erieco.gov/1672 · trailforks.com/region/erie-singletrack-15128
- Coal Creek Disc Golf Course: 18 holes, par 56, free to play, rated 4.1/5 on UDisc (3,000+ reviews); elevation changes, mountain views, and a ditch water hazard. udisc.com/courses/coal-creek-disc-golf-course-wzBo · erieco.gov/1776
- Colorado National Golf Club (2700 Vista Pkwy, Erie): premier public championship course, home of the University of Colorado golf teams, host of NCAA/USGA events; Master's Restaurant on site. coloradonationalgolfclub.com

## About Erie, Colorado

Erie sits on the Boulder–Weld county line along the Colorado Front Range, roughly 20 minutes from Boulder and 35 from Denver. It pairs a walkable historic downtown with newer master-planned neighborhoods, top-rated St. Vrain Valley schools, and a strong parks-and-recreation culture. Buyers searching "Erie Colorado homes for sale," "Erie CO houses for sale," or "Erie Colorado real estate" will find 1050 Highlands Dr representative of the town's newer family homes: built 2022, energy-efficient, and positioned inside an amenity-rich community.
